scope: Per-actor mutable arenas and stable, layout-independent dense entity semantics

physical_index.aosoa: tile * tile_width * fields + field * tile_width + lane
physical_index.soaos: tile * tile_width * fields + first_field * tile_width + lane * group_fields + (field - first_field); first_field = floor(field/2)*2, group_fields = min(2, fields - first_field)

rules.guest_allocation: actor-owned by default, for all actor kinds including shared
rules.handles: opaque issued capability identity, actor-incarnation and lifetime fenced
rules.state: one state schema; state access only under validated critical state loan
rules.persistent: lives through successive actor turns until freed or retired
rules.scratch: per-message scratch survives suspension, is inaccessible to other message turns, and scrubs only when its own outstanding message completes; actor-global nextTurn is serial-only
rules.borrows: no mutation, compaction, re-layout or turn transition with live read lease
rules.message: actor-owned mutable arena references never cross actor boundaries
rules.shared: explicit separate immutable lease or validated synchronized shared capability
rules.retirement: seal actor authority immediately; physical reclaim waits for all outstanding message lifetimes, read loans, pins, and tasks
rules.layout: one authoritative mutable physical backing per epoch; transactional conversions
rules.ecs: stable opaque entity handles, generation fenced, swap-delete preserves surviving identity
rules.isolation: ownership and independent collectors/OS sandboxes are different claims
rules.input_snapshot: own dense F64 DATA descriptors copied before any row write; accessor or reentrant mutation rejected
rules.authority_quotas: max 4096 simultaneously live allocation handles, read loans, external pins, and tasks, independently
rules.host_metadata: JS reference model charges guest payload bytes but not all host Map/handle bookkeeping; no production memory accounting claim
rules.message_lane: at most one message executes actor code at a time, despite many concurrent outstanding message lifetimes
rules.legacy_transition: global scratch and outstanding global read loans must drain before entering message-lifetime mode
rules.message_scoped_external_dependencies: active external lifetime pins and descendant task lifetimes retain the originating message's scratch until explicit release; off-carrier release allowed, no guest byte authority implied

promotion_gate.per_backend: real Oreslang guest compiler + runtime, source/tree/toolchain pins, executed steps, independent review
promotion_gate.guest_execution: per-backend compiler emitted guest code + real runtime execution required; source-free model cannot certify
